decision_log: [fx-nyc-high-20261118] skip GAP-NYC-FORECAST: outcome forecast changes event probability, not settlement risk; research-only, no trades.

[fx-nyc-high-20261118] GAP-NYC-SETTLE: free official-source check (Contract terms PDF: Weather_Terms_and_Conditions_67323dd4-5775-48d5-bea0-c33d672d1f74.pdf, NWS Climatological Report (Daily) for Central Park, product CLINYC) -> inconclusive. Rule 13.111(i)(2) settles on the first published version that confirms the value, so later revisions and corrections do not count. But the rule text is missing a word after 'confirmation of the', and NWS publishes a same-day CLINYC before the full-day one (Nov 17: issued 4:38 PM EST, valid as of 4:00 PM, max 57F at 3:55 PM). The terms do not say whether that partial-day report counts as the first published version, so the gap stays open.
[fx-nyc-high-20261118] PROPOSE cat-nws-cli-settlement-version-v1 for GAP-NYC-SETTLE: max 50000 base units (= 0.05 USDC), unsigned.
